An existing attendee stored as 'Bob@X.com' and submitted as 'bob@x.com' would bypass the duplicate filter and be re-added as a new booking attendee row, and would receive AttendeeAddGuestsEmail rather than AttendeeScheduledEmail. The mechanism is fully verifiable from the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, uniqueGuests is computed with strict, case-sensitive comparisons: `guest === attendee.email` and `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` (guest is not lowercased while blacklist entries are), so emails differing only by case can bypass both checks and be inserted via `createMany`, producing duplicate attendee rows and potentially bypassing the blacklist. In email-manager.ts `sendAddGuestsEmails` uses `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` which is also case-sensitive, so a case mismatch will cause the wrong template branch to be chosen.
